source: Original (authored October 2026, calculator allowed). Sine rule and area of a triangle: ABC (A = 40, B = 65, BC = 8); PQR (P = 35, PQ = 10, QR = 8, R acute); sides 6 and 9 with 30 deg between; sides 5 and 10 with area 20.

parts.label: a
parts.description: In triangle ABC, angle A = 40 deg, angle B = 65 deg, BC = 8. Find AC.
parts.tolerance: Accept 11.3 or the display with an ellipsis (11.2797...). A value cut short without an ellipsis (11.28) earns A0.
parts.notes: M1 for a correct sine rule equation pairing each side with its opposite angle: AC/sin 65 = 8/sin 40, in either orientation. A1 for 11.3.

parts.label: b
parts.description: Find the area of triangle ABC.
parts.tolerance: Accept 43.6 or the display with an ellipsis (43.5814...). Accept any value consistent with the candidate's own correctly-rounded AC, including 43.7 from AC = 11.3. A value cut short without an ellipsis (43.58) earns A0.
parts.notes: A1 for angle C = 75 deg (may be seen in the area expression). M1 for (1/2)ab sin C using two sides and the angle between them: (1/2)(8)(AC) sin 75, or (1/2)(AB)(AC) sin 40 with AB found by the sine rule. A1 for 43.6.
parts.follow_through: FT from the candidate's AC in (a).

parts.label: c
parts.description: In triangle PQR, angle P = 35 deg, PQ = 10, QR = 8, and angle R is acute. Find angle R.
parts.tolerance: Accept 45.8 or the display with an ellipsis (45.8049...). The obtuse value 134.2 earns A0 because R is stated to be acute.
parts.notes: M1 for a correct sine rule equation: sin R/10 = sin 35/8, in either orientation. A1 for 45.8.

parts.label: d
parts.description: Find the exact area of a triangle with sides 6 and 9 and 30 deg between them.

parts.label: e
parts.description: A triangle has sides 5 cm and 10 cm and area 20 cm^2; the angle between them is acute. Find this angle.
parts.tolerance: Accept 53.1 or the display with an ellipsis (53.1301...). The obtuse value 126.9 earns A0.
parts.notes: M1 for the equation (1/2)(5)(10) sin theta = 20. A1 for 53.1.

source: Original (authored October 2026, calculator allowed). River: A and B 200 m apart on one bank, tree T on the opposite parallel bank, angle TAB = 52, angle TBA = 71. Garden: sides 8 m and 10 m, area 30 m^2, acute included angle.

parts.label: a
parts.notes: A1 for 57 deg. 'Write down': no working needed.

parts.label: b
parts.tolerance: Accept 225 or the display with an ellipsis (225.480...). Units not required. A value cut short without an ellipsis (225.5) earns A0.
parts.notes: M1 for a correct sine rule equation: AT/sin 71 = 200/sin(their angle ATB). A1 for 225.
parts.follow_through: FT from the candidate's angle ATB in (a).

parts.label: c
parts.description: Find the width of the river (perpendicular distance from T to AB).
parts.tolerance: Accept 178 or the display with an ellipsis (177.680...). Accept any value consistent with the candidate's own correctly-rounded intermediate, including 177 from AT = 225. A value cut short without an ellipsis (177.7) earns A0.
parts.notes: M1 for any correct right-angled trigonometry for the perpendicular height: AT sin 52, or BT sin 71 with BT = 187.92... from the sine rule, or 2 x area / 200. A1 for 178.
parts.follow_through: FT from the candidate's AT in (b).

parts.label: d
parts.description: Find the area of triangle ABT.
parts.tolerance: Accept 17800 (or 1.78 x 10^4) or the display with an ellipsis (17768.0...). Accept any value consistent with the candidate's own correctly-rounded intermediate, including 17700 from AT = 225. A value cut short without an ellipsis (17768) earns A0.
parts.notes: M1 for any correct area expression: (1/2)(200)(AT) sin 52, (1/2)(200)(BT) sin 71, or (1/2)(200)(width). A1 for 17800.
parts.follow_through: FT from the candidate's AT in (b) or width in (c).

parts.label: e
parts.description: A triangular garden has sides 8 m and 10 m and area 30 m^2; the angle between them is acute. Find this angle.
parts.tolerance: Accept 48.6 or the display with an ellipsis (48.5903...). The obtuse value 131.4 earns A0.
parts.notes: M1 for the equation (1/2)(8)(10) sin theta = 30. A1 for 48.6.
